verdict.rationale: The evidence points to prebuilt distribution: the official CLI is published via GitHub releases, and hands-on users installed rcli through Homebrew and an install script, so compiling from source is not required. However, no first-party docs in the pack describe the install channels or SDK package-manager artifacts. Hands-on reports also say not everything loads properly when installed via Homebrew and that the install methods tried did not work. Missing for 10: first-party install docs for prebuilt binaries/packages, documented SDK package-manager distribution, platform coverage of binaries, reliable working Homebrew/script installs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: not everything loads properly when installed via homebrew
